biography_sections.title: The named Gairbraid mother
biography_sections.markdown: Hill reports the senior John/Marion/eldest-John confirmation on 19 November 1582 and explicitly calls Thomas the younger son. Agnes belongs to the eldest son’s family. [Inspected printed p. 53](https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n78.jpg). The original charter and manuscripts were not inspected. Visually checked [printed p. 87](https://archive.org/download/earlyrecordsofol00hill/page/n114.jpg) supports this generational distinction; it is from the same compiled book, and the underlying originals remain uninspected.

biography_sections.title: Recorded aliases and a cautious date bound
biography_sections.markdown: Wilson and Jarden are recorded names; neither is asserted as a proved maiden surname. Birth before 1583 is a conservative documentary upper bound; no birthplace, survival in 1582 or death is inferred.
